payload.name: pc-check-channel-list
payload.description: Pure-logic validator for a raw channel list. Accepts a list (including an empty list) whose items are exact integers 0..255 inclusive; rejects bool, float, null, missing and wrong types. Returns an advisory object only; it performs no Tool dispatch, reply or effect. Unapproved target-interface draft; the inputs mapping and Monty execution are runtime prerequisites, not established support.
